title: iberis intermedia subsp. timeroyi
intro: Iberis intermedia subsp. timeroyi, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant, possibly alleviating symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and sedative properties, making it a potential natural remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders. Bioactive constituents of Rock Cress include glucosinolates, which may be responsible for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
